tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring nail polish on a plane?

travelTips: Nail polish is a liquid and is subject to the 3-1-1 liquids rule. Individual bottles in carry-on must be 3.4 oz (100 ml) or less.

faq.question: Is nail polish allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Nail Polish is restricted in carry-on luggage. Nail polish is a liquid and is subject to the 3-1-1 liquids rule. Individual bottles in carry-on must be 3.4 oz (100 ml) or less.

faq.question: Can you pack nail polish in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Nail Polish is allowed in checked bags. Nail polish and nail polish remover are allowed in checked baggage.
